expected_facts.text: The consumer is idempotent by request identifier.
Ordering is required only within one customer account.
Transient failures may be retried three times with exponential backoff.
Exhausted messages move to a dead-letter queue and require a recorded cause before replay.
Payloads exclude access tokens and raw personal identifiers.
Audit request identifiers are retained for thirty days.
